note: The Veth builds (WP17, owner 2026-10-17: Lean/Average/Heavy plus one more at each end). Sliders are Creator Fat and Muscularity steps away from the Average body (the owner's blend: Blend_M fat -0.96, muscularity +0.06; Blend_F fat -0.56, muscularity -0.30), kept inside the Creator's preset spread (fat -1.49..+1.65) so every build stays a natural body. The extremes ship only if every garment passes the clipping gate on them. mpfb: MakeHuman macro steps (weight, muscle) from the production (MPFB) players' own macros, for the production family's build models (mpfb_specs.py). arm_splay_deg: the build's pose offset - upper arms turned out from the trunk after the clips (Art/BuildPose.cs), chosen by the gate so the arm swing clears the build's own sides.
